title: Project Manager Mechanical Engineering (f/m/d)
description:
We build packaging machines and are looking for a project manager for customer projects.

What you'll do
- Manage machine projects from order to acceptance
- Coordinate design, purchasing, assembly and service

What you bring
- Experience in project management or project coordination in mechanical engineering, in which you keep track of deadlines, costs and quality across several parallel orders, coordinate suppliers and internal departments, follow changes to bills of materials and design revisions, prepare status reports for senior management and prepare customer acceptances, ideally with SAP and MS Project
- University degree or technician qualification
- English skills for dealing with suppliers
